showcase_arsenal_description: Every layer has a home, a contract, and a reason to exist. Read the decisions behind the shape.
showcase_decision_one: Capabilities stay shared so REST, MCP, server functions, and workers cannot drift apart.
showcase_decision_two: Optional providers remain inactive when their environment is empty, keeping local evaluation honest.
showcase_decision_three: The Seed and Live adapters represent the same demo identity, so navigation behaves the same in both modes.
showcase_trace_description: Follow one real overview request through the typed boundary, shared capability, and Cloudflare bindings. The panels quote source files from this repository.
showcase_proof_shared_detail: One capability is composed by the web app, REST API, MCP server, and background workers.
showcase_proof_contract_detail: Routes declare params, success schemas, and typed failures together under the bearer-authenticated API group.
showcase_proof_runtime_detail: Unset provider environment variables keep optional integrations inactive during local evaluation.
showcase_proof_demo_detail: Open the seeded Reference Application to inspect members, roles, notifications, and audit events.
